text:
- **Site answers to agent questions:** Claude and Codex agents now raise questions on the site, as well as in chat. The first answer wins, and the site shows each question with its options and a free-text field.
- **Faster CI and Go tests:** Each pull request starts at most two macOS jobs and runs only the Go tests its changes can affect. macOS test compute fell by about a fifth. Wall time stayed above the targets.
- **Agent guide and code cleanup:** The agent guide is now a short map that every runtime reads in full. A check grades it on each pull request, and the old Python-port code is gone.
- **Agent work without leave:** Agents open a project, sprint or task for an owner request without asking leave first.
